## 3. The evidence that moved it

**Cell therapy stopped needing a factory.** Two papers in one month generate CAR
T cells inside the patient: [41851456](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41851456/) (*Nature*) reprograms T
cells in vivo by site-specific engineering, and [41882404](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41882404/)
(*Nat Med*) reports first-in-human in vivo generation of anti-BCMA CAR-T in
relapsed/refractory myeloma. Ex vivo manufacturing is the cost, delay and
access constraint on the entire platform; removing it changes who can be
treated more than any receptor redesign in this corpus.

**The tumour microbiome was told to start over.** [41650974](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41650974/)
(*Cancer Cell*) states that most published tumour-microbiome signatures are
contamination artifacts that do not reproduce without stringent controls. Two
months later [42092351](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42092351/) (*Cell*) supplies the replacement — a
contamination-aware pan-cancer map of intratumoral bacteria and fungi. Treat
every tumour-microbiome claim in this corpus dated before April 2026 as
provisional; the field re-grounded itself in public and the correction is
usable.

**ctDNA got its first clean prospective win.** [41813900](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41813900/)
(*Nature*) validates risk-adaptive therapy guided by dynamic ctDNA prospectively
in nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Against a thread that is otherwise dominated by
refutations — SERENA-6 quality of life, TOMBOLA, tumour-naive MRD
underperformance — this is the design that works: a disease with a clean viral
marker, and a randomized structure where ctDNA sets the therapy rather than
annotating it.

**Foundation models split cleanly by task type again.** [Evo 2](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41781614/)
models and designs genomes across all domains of life, and
[CellVoyager](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41845065/) autonomously analyses single-cell data with a
benchmark across 76 studies. Meanwhile an ensemble's worth of ESM capability
[distils into one small model](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41912799/), undercutting the scale-first
assumption from the inside.

## 4. Refutations

### (a) Landing on a tracked thread

The microbiome-contamination card above is filed as a refutation on
`neuro-immune-microbiome-axis`, and it is the largest single hit that thread has
taken. Note what it does *not* touch: the neural arm. Four supports this month —
[serotonin and lineage plasticity](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41416996/), [sensory neurons driving a
fibrotic immune microenvironment](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41677804/),
[lymphocyte-intrinsic cholinergic circuits](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41735533/), and
[sympathetic nerves setting baseline immunosurveillance](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41785384/) — are all
neural, none microbial. The thread is one mechanism network by claim, but its
two arms are not in the same evidentiary state, and the microbial arm is the
weaker one.

[41606121](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41606121/) (*Nat Med*) is the exception worth reading: faecal
transplant plus checkpoint blockade where benefit tracks **loss of deleterious
taxa, not donor engraftment**. That inverts the standard model of what FMT does
and is the most actionable microbiome card in the corpus.

### (b) Method credibility

Four cards, and three of them are about reproducibility of the analysis rather
than of the biology. [41903535](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41903535/) (*Cell Syst*): identical
single-cell data give materially different clusters and differential expression
across *package versions*. [41775267](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41775267/): gene essentiality calls do
not transfer across genetic backgrounds — every DepMap-derived target list
inherits this. [41998753](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41998753/): a recurrent instrument-chemistry
artifact produces false somatic variant calls on two-colour Illumina platforms.

On the model side, [40500472](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40500472/) (*Nat Biotechnol*) is the sharpest:
standard cell-embedding benchmark metrics *reward* embeddings that destroy
biological structure. This is the second of three months in which the metric,
rather than the method, is what fails — see June's
[40739072](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40739072/) on silhouette-based integration metrics.
[41922570](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41922570/): protein language model embeddings carry unquantified,
task-dependent uncertainty, so downstream confidence is uncalibrated.
